claims.kickoff_quote: Hand the auditor all three of the things it establishes before it can map law to controls, rather than letting it guess them: which regulations actually apply, what categories of personal or regulated data this milestone touches, and which jurisdictions the users and the data sit in.
claims.skill_quote: 1. Establish organizational scope, applicable regulations, data types, and geography.
claims.reasoning: The three enumerated items are a one-to-one re-listing of the agent's own step 1 (applicable regulations / data types / geography), and the KICKOFF text even says these are things 'it establishes' — conceding the agent already owns them. The residual instruction ('supply them rather than let it guess') is a thin wrapper around a list the agent's first numbered step already fixes; only the scoping word 'this milestone' is operator-supplied.

claims.kickoff_quote: Point it at any prior audit history and existing control or policy docs too.
claims.skill_quote: 2. Review existing controls, policies, and prior audit history.
claims.reasoning: Near word-for-word restatement of the agent's step 2 — same three nouns (controls, policies, prior audit history) in the same order. It names no path, artifact, or filename, so it adds no invocation argument the agent lacks; it merely re-teaches the agent's own second phase.

claims.kickoff_quote: Disclosure deadlines start running from discovery, not from the fix, so surface the applicable regime and its clock to me while the incident is still open.
claims.skill_quote: SEARCH EVIDENCE — closest sentence in the asset is the Output section, line 25: 'An audit report: executive summary, per-control findings with evidence, a risk matrix, and a prioritized remediation roadmap. State control-coverage percentage and any critical findings.' The asset's only other mention of deadlines is line 17 ('breach-notification deadlines') as a topic area. Greps run over compliance-auditor.md (no references/ dir exists — confirmed by ls of plugins/dev-kit-core/agents/): -niE 'deadline|clock|early|interim|urgent|immediat|discovery|72|notif' returned only lines 17 and 25.
